items.expected_conclusion: A validated computation should report whether oxidation contracts or expands the sulfur separation and delimit what that structural observation supports about odd-electron S–S interaction.
items.statement: Oxidation of norDTCO contracts the S16-S17 separation. The comparison uses both validated state geometries and the signed radical-cation-minus-neutral distance difference to assess the odd-electron S-S interaction.
